# About This Volume {.unnumbered .unlisted}

This is **Volume 1 of 3** of *Biostatistics Practicum*. The book is
also published whole, as a single continuously numbered site, at
<https://practicum.rgtlab.org>. The print edition is split into
three volumes only because a single bound book would be too long to
handle comfortably.

**This volume**, *Data, Toolkit, and a First Look*, opens with the
two worked case studies (Palmer Penguins and ADNI) and the HF-HOME
capstone, read first as a preview of where the book is going. It
then covers why reproducible research matters and team science,
the toolkit (shell, workstation, Git for solo and team work, renv,
Docker, compendium assembly, and AI-assisted coding), and working
with data (acquisition, APIs, wrangling, types, functions, joins,
databases, graphics, and missing data). Together these follow the
first quarter of the two-quarter sequence.

**Volume 2**, *Documents, Pipelines, and Communication*, covers
Quarto documents, targets pipelines, and cloud compute,
communicating a finished analysis, and federal requirements. It also carries the book's
full reference apparatus: the glossary, cheat sheets, the
instructor guide, the rgtlab software appendix, and the colophon.
If you need any of those while reading this volume, they are in
Volume 2.

**Volume 3**, *Industry Practice*, covers de-identification and
ethics, statistical analysis plans, testing and continuous
integration, and the pharmaceutical industry chapters (CDISC and
SAS). It is the one-quarter supplement for pharmaceutical-track
students.

Cross-references within this volume work as usual. A reference to
material in another volume is written as plain text, using that
volume's own chapter numbers, for example 'Chapter 2 ('Reproducible
Reports with Quarto') in Volume 2'. We do this because a printed
volume cannot link into a book it is not bound with.
